scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Encouraging Worker's Children's Participation in Sports Activities- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Financial Assistance for Encouraging Worker’s Children’s Participation in Sports Activities scheme is an initiative launched by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

This scheme was introduced to promote sports among the children of workers in Haryana.

The official launch date of this scheme was on 1st January 2020.

The primary objective of this scheme is to encourage children of registered workers to participate in various sports activities.

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to support their participation in state, national, and international sports events.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board has set a measurable target to support at least 1,000 children annually under this scheme.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is up to INR 50,000 per child.

This amount can be utilized for training, equipment, travel, and other expenses related to sports participation.

The scheme is specifically designed for children aged between 6 to 18 years.

To be eligible for this scheme, the applicant must be a child of a registered worker in Haryana.

The family income of the worker should not exceed INR 2 lakh per annum.

The worker must be registered under the Haryana Labour Welfare Fund Act, 2008.

To apply for this scheme, the applicant must follow a specific process.

First, the applicant needs to obtain the application form from the Haryana Labour Welfare Board’s official website or their local office.

The application form must be filled out completely with accurate details.

The applicant must attach a copy of the worker's registration certificate.

A copy of the child's birth certificate is also required to verify age eligibility.

Additionally, the applicant must provide proof of the family income.

This can be in the form of an income certificate issued by a competent authority.

The completed application form along with the required documents should be submitted to the local Labour Welfare Board office.

The application must be submitted within the specified timeline which is usually within three months of the sports event.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board reviews the applications on a quarterly basis.

The disbursement of financial assistance occurs within 30 days of the approval of the application.

The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana.

The contact details for the Haryana Labour Welfare Board are available on their official website.

The board can be reached at their headquarters located in Panchkula, Haryana.

The scheme has seen an increase in participation among children of workers since its inception.

In the year 2021, approximately 1,200 children benefited from this scheme.

The financial assistance has enabled many children to participate in sports events that they otherwise could not afford.

The scheme covers a wide range of sports including athletics, wrestling, boxing, and team sports like football and cricket.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board also collaborates with various sports associations to promote this initiative.

The board conducts awareness programs to inform workers about the benefits of this scheme.

Feedback from beneficiaries has shown a positive impact on children's performance in sports.

The scheme not only encourages physical fitness but also aims to instill discipline and teamwork among children.

In addition to financial assistance, the scheme also provides guidance and mentorship for young athletes.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board organizes workshops and training camps for selected children.

These camps are conducted by professional coaches and sports experts.

The scheme has been instrumental in identifying and nurturing talent among the children of workers.

Parents are encouraged to support their children's participation in sports through this initiative.

The board aims to create a culture of sports and physical activity among the working class.

The success of this scheme is measured by the number of children who excel in sports at various levels.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board has plans to expand the scheme to include more sports disciplines in the future.

The board is also exploring partnerships with educational institutions to promote sports education.

The scheme is part of a larger initiative by the government to enhance the overall well-being of workers and their families.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board is committed to ensuring that financial constraints do not hinder children's participation in sports.

The scheme has received positive feedback from various stakeholders including parents, sports coaches, and community leaders.

The board regularly reviews the scheme to make necessary adjustments based on feedback and changing needs.

The Financial Assistance for Encouraging Worker’s Children’s Participation in Sports Activities scheme is a significant step towards empowering the next generation of athletes in Haryana.

The initiative reflects the government's commitment to promoting sports and physical fitness among all sections of society.

The scheme not only benefits individual children but also contributes to the development of sports culture in the state.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board continues to strive for excellence in implementing this scheme.

The board encourages all eligible families to take advantage of this opportunity.

The scheme is a testament to the importance of sports in fostering a healthy and active lifestyle among children.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board remains dedicated to supporting the aspirations of young athletes in the state.
